notes.title: Networking Improvements Underway!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re currently focused on stabilizing the game’s networking systems to ensure a smoother and more reliable gameplay experience.

Once the stability work is complete, we’ll move forward with balancing adjustments and demo build preparations. These steps are essential as we gear up for future playtests.

Thank you so much for your continued support and patience — exciting things are on the way!

Stay tuned!
